shared_context.topic: differential diagnosis of right lower abdominal pain

snippets.output: Right lower abdominal pain has several potential causes.
Appendicitis is a common cause of right lower quadrant abdominal pain, and it is particularly common in young adults.
snippets.notes: Both atoms describe properties of appendicitis as a cause; 33yo female fits the young-adult demographic.
snippets.pattern_notes: Both atoms enumerate properties of appendicitis.

snippets.output: Appendicitis occurs when the appendix becomes inflamed, often due to a blockage or infection.
snippets.pattern_notes: Causal mechanism: inflammation due to blockage/infection.

snippets.output: Symptoms of appendicitis may include pain that starts near the navel and then moves to the lower right abdomen, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, and fever.
Ovarian cysts are fluid-filled sacs that can develop on the ovaries.
Ovarian torsion occurs when the ovary twists, cutting off its blood supply.
snippets.notes: Standalone definition of ovarian torsion (distinct entity from cysts).
snippets.pattern_notes: Standalone definition, distinct entity from prior (cysts).

snippets.output: Ovarian cysts and ovarian torsion can cause right lower abdominal pain, especially if the cyst or ovary is located on the right side.
snippets.notes: Conclusion (RLQ pain from ovarian conditions) with the side-localization premise; highly relevant for a 33yo female.
snippets.pattern_notes: Conclusion (ovarian conditions cause RLQ pain) with localization premise.

snippets.output: Kidney stones can cause severe pain in the right lower back or side, which may radiate to the abdomen.
snippets.notes: Pain location plus radiation; generally true and applicable.
snippets.pattern_notes: Properties of kidney stone pain (location and radiation).

snippets.output: Pain from kidney stones is often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and frequent urination.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of associated symptoms of kidney-stone pain.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of associated symptoms of kidney-stone pain.

snippets.output: Diverticulitis is an inflammation of the diverticula, which are small pouches in the wall of the colon.
snippets.notes: Definition plus property of diverticula (same subject).

snippets.output: Diverticulitis can cause right lower abdominal pain, especially if the affected diverticula are located in the right colon.
snippets.notes: Conclusion plus localization premise. Diverticulitis is uncommon at age 33 (typically >50) and right-sided diverticulitis is rare in Western populations, so this is an atypical differential for this patient, but it is not strictly false in context.

snippets.output: Gastrointestinal issues, including irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), can cause right lower abdominal pain.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of GI causes of RLQ pain.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of GI causes of RLQ pain.

snippets.output: Conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) can cause right lower abdominal pain.
snippets.notes: GERD causes epigastric/retrosternal pain, not right lower abdominal pain. Incorrect both generally and for this 33yo female.
snippets.pattern_notes: Isolated false atom kept apart from true GI causes.

snippets.output: It is essential to consult a healthcare professional for a proper diagnosis and treatment plan.
A healthcare professional will likely perform a physical examination and take a medical history.
A healthcare professional may order imaging tests such as an ultrasound, CT scan, or MRI to determine the underlying cause of symptoms.
snippets.notes: Enumeration of imaging modalities for the same purpose.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumeration of imaging modalities for the same purpose.
